g.text: Both responses rise. The female-cue response stays stronger.
Recorded activity in the full-connectome model — no mating-choice rule was used.
After mAL block, the mean female-cue response was 5.5–5.6× the male-cue response.
Small circles: three fresh random seeds. Diamonds: means. Lines pair identical inputs before/after the block.
This measures modeled neural responsiveness, not the probability of choosing a mate; transmitter signs remain assumptions.
